source.pc: In this skill you learn to solve a linear equation. If you have an equation like then you will be able to determine the solution for . This includes expanding any potential brackets, moving terms around, merging similar terms together and eventually solving the resulting product equation. The latter also includes simplifying the result as well as checking it. This skill does not deal with equations with fractions containing in the denominator.

A linear equation is an equation like , containing only terms with a number or a number times . Sometimes there are also numbers multiplied by brackets, like in , but there are no squares or more complicated terms. This skill is about solving such an equation to find which value of satisfies it.

In fact, you may recognize that it's now a product equation.
